observations: AS-09 achieved 0.9201100425 on the official DACON leaderboard, establishing a new all-time high score for the project.
Score improvement over previous best (AS-06/AS-07: 0.9122153056) is +0.0078947369 (+0.78947369 percentage points).
Score improvement over AS-08 (0.9003732004) is +0.0197368421 (+1.97368421 percentage points).
Server execution time was 8분 17초 (497 seconds), well within the competition limit of 1,200 seconds.
Confirms that DPR-SYMPHON-02 with complete package bundling and working Dense inference successfully executes on the evaluation server and produces genuine performance gains.
interpretations: The resolution of the AS-08 missing loss.py dependency allowed HybridDenseLexicalMatcher to run actively on the server without silent fallback.
DPR-SYMPHON-02's syllable 1D-CNN blocks, multi-query attention, fleet prefix decoupling, and CosFace hard-negative learning generalized effectively to the unseen competition test set.
Retaining the high-confidence catalog_full_ko_map and train lookup provided a stable lexical foundation while DPR-SYMPHON-02 elevated foreign/unseen vessel retrieval.
limitations: No private test input/label/row prediction inspected or saved (competition blind evaluation).
Breakdown between Hangul accuracy and non-Hangul accuracy cannot be observed directly from the single aggregate score.
Exact server test set size and stage-by-stage runtime breakdown remain unverified.
decision: Promote AS-09 / DPR-SYMPHON-02 as the new project benchmark and best verified submission package.
next_actions: Update PROJECT_STATUS.md and INDEX.csv to record the new high score.
Maintain AS-09 package assets as the primary reference for future iterations.
